frameIndexConvention: zero-based inclusive start, exclusive end; all original consecutive source frames at 24fps

idle.selection: Quiet standing interval before the blink/celebration transition. Almost static breathing; no artificial ping-pong or repeated frames.
limits: No complete blink in this selected loop.

diagnostic.note: Ratio high only because both absolute differences are tiny; no visible pose discontinuity.

walk.selection: Best existing female early-gait candidate with comparatively relaxed arms, both alternating support/pass phases, and matching start/end phase. This is a fast-walk candidate, not a fully accepted ordinary walk.
limits: Some extended-foot poses appear briefly light or airborne; cannot certify continuous single-foot ground contact.
Face/torso viewpoint differs slightly from 1927 and 2394; uniform anchor/scale normalization cannot remove it.
Do not claim a complete production-quality ordinary walk from these sources.

alternative.reason: Another full two-step cycle, slightly worse multi-frame phase match.

run.selection: One full left/right gait cycle, with near and far arm/leg alternation and the same phase returning after 18 frames. Preserves original 0.75-second cadence.
limits: Loop selection does not prove in-game foot-speed/world-speed alignment.

alternative.reason: Earlier full gait cycle with slightly less consistent phase match.

jump.selection: First uncropped jump only, including deceleration/crouch, takeoff, flight, landing and partial recovery up to last grounded frame before second takeoff.
limits: Starts in braking/running-to-crouch transition, not relaxed idle.
Frame233 is a grounded near-straight-knee rebound preparation with bent arms and visible motion blur, not a neutral settled standing pose.
No continuous first-jump-to-relaxed-idle recovery exists before the source immediately begins a second jump.
Do not synthesize a tail, auto-loop or crossfade into idle and call it seamless.

alternative.reason: Avoids blurred final straightening frame but leaves a more crouched landing pose.

celebrate.selection: Full source onset and return to relaxed standing. Replaces initial 15-frame celebration-loop candidate after verifying f344-350 recovery.
limits: Several fist raises, hands beside ears.
One-shot; does not promise a seamless transition to another source.

notes: No new drawing, interpolation, time remapping, per-frame warping or per-frame scale normalization was performed.
Numerical boundary metrics are diagnostics, not art acceptance.
All source footage remains unchanged. Native f233 was checked at full1920x1080.
noteScope: Selection analysis; temporary source-comparison paths omitted. Final export contract is artwork/kling-side-selection/selection.json.

celebrationLoopAlternative.selection: One complete raised-fists to chest and raised-fists cycle, feet grounded. Uses native 0.625-second timing.
limits: Starts and ends with fists raised rather than idle.
Hands rise beside ears, not merely to shoulder height.
Standalone loop does not include idle-entry or exit transition.
